responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation-URL companion for the main Xtensa target option table. It maps machine options declared in `xtensa.opt`—such as ABI selection, long-call handling, literal-pool controls, alignment, and volatile-serialization switches—to their GCC manual anchors, supplying the option metadata layer used by help output and diagnostics while leaving the actual option definitions and backend behavior to `xtensa.opt`, `xtensa.h`, and `xtensa.cc`.
